answer: A single Harvestkeeper cart trial entered in the vineyard warrant does the work of a whole committee: 5-year cellar service, 44 supervised pressings, blending exam, annual ledger dues, verified by a stranger. Faking at scale is a payroll: 479 aliases, each demanding 107 POA and 14 minutes, a standing bill of 51253 POA. The zenith proves one person, the prism prices one forgery, and the island remembers one epoch after another. The defence holds because the attacker pays and the honest agent does not.
